name: priority-dev-pi-extension
title: The priority reader runs in Pi and OMP, and a coding agent can read a session
outcome: The cobuilder-priority digest and action cards run as a Pi extension. It behaves the same as the Claude Code plugin in both Pi and OMP. A coding agent can run the digest and get the action cards back as a structured response. Later, a Pi Durable orchestrator gets the digest and cards each time a hook fires in a harness it started.
done_when: One Pi package loads in Pi and in OMP with no fork, and gives the same card and draft text as plugins/cobuilder-priority for the same reading
A coding agent runs priority read on a Claude Code or Pi session file and gets the digest and the cards as JSON, not as rendered UI
Designed as planned epics, not built: a Pi Durable orchestrator, using PiHarness, starts a child agent and gets the digest and cards when the child's hooks fire
The orchestrator answers a card for the user or notifies the user, and the decision rule is a pure evaluate with table tests
abort_if: A probe shows that one Pi package cannot catch a main-loop stop exactly once in both Pi and OMP
A probe shows that neither host can hold a question tool open while the person answers in the pane
On a labelled sample of Pi or OMP stops, D1 scores clearly below the Claude Code baseline of 0.654
Pi Durable cannot deliver a child event to its orchestrator by any route. This pauses epics E8 to E10, not the Pi package

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts (scripts, commands, docs), 6 ADRs (ADR-0016, ADR-0017, ADR-0025, ADR-0045, ADR-0051, ADR-0052), 2 contexts (cobuilder-priority, priority-dev), generic stack card rule 1

epics.title: Probe: the stop events, the pane, the question hold, and the session header in Pi and OMP.
epics.outcome: A probe record answers unknowns 1 to 3 for each host, and confirms the OMP session header.

epics.title: priority-dev: transcript adapters for claude-code and pi, and the priority transcript.
epics.outcome: The 56 scored briefs stay byte-identical, and a Pi or OMP session gives a brief.

epics.title: priority-dev: priority read prints one Reading as JSON.
epics.outcome: A coding agent runs priority read on a Claude Code or Pi session and gets the digest and the cards as JSON.

epics.title: Score D1 on a labelled sample of Pi and OMP stops, before any host code.
epics.outcome: A score report writes the calibration file of priority-dev, or abort gate 3 stops the design.

epics.title: The shared TypeScript core, and the Claude Code plugin on it.
epics.outcome: The Claude Code tests pass unchanged, the golden readings give the same card and draft text, and the boundary records cover the core.

epics.title: Pi package: install, settings, the switch, the stop reading, the pane, the marks, Send, and the priority_read tool.
epics.outcome: In Pi and OMP, a stop gives a card in the pane, Send submits the draft, and the boundary record covers pi/cobuilder-priority.

epics.title: The question hook for the question tool of each host.
epics.outcome: In Pi, a main-loop question opens a question card, and Send answers it. In OMP this holds only when probe E1 shows the hold works. Otherwise OMP question stops are not supported.

epics.title: Probe: the route from a PiHarness child to its orchestrator and to a reader.
epics.outcome: A probe record names one working route. A container child that runs the Pi package is the first candidate.

epics.title: evaluate and the rules file from schemas.md section 4, with the two ADR-0053 guards, in the core.
epics.outcome: Table tests over the golden readings pass, and each decision records the rule id, the policy hash, the action hash, and the state digest.

epics.title: Pi Durable orchestrator: the child hook, the advisor, the actuator, and notifications.
epics.outcome: The orchestrator answers an allowed card in a child, or notifies the person, and records the decision.

rounds.note: Draft review 0.68. The engineer took survivor S1 (score D1 first, now E4), named S2 the first E8 candidate, and set the starting policy to schemas.md section 4 with two guards. Record fixes F1 to F11.
The engineer approved the draft and chose one pull request.
Gate 2b feedback: OMP question stops are not supported when the ask call cannot be held. No read-only fallback card.
